verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that an official Microsoft MCP server is documented at github.com/microsoft/mcp, so Azure itself provides this capability. The evidence is a single thin mention with no detail on Azure tool coverage, setup, auth, or agent-client compatibility. Missing for 10: documented Azure-specific MCP tools and scope, setup and authentication flow for connecting an agent, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
